heroes.name: Miu

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.targets: All heroes in the center of the battlefield
skills.description: Creates a flash that blinds all heroes in the center of the battlefield for 6.0 seconds and deals magic damage to enemies. While affected by any Blindness, allies always hit enemies and their attacks cannot be evaded. Miu is always Blinded.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.description: Blindness now affects the entire battlefield.

skills.name: Veil of Insight
skills.targets: The ally in front of Miu
skills.description: Blinds the ally in front of her for 5.0 seconds. Any Blindness affecting allies increases their Magical Crit Hit chance.

skills.name: Veil of Insight
skills.description: Magical Critical Hits from blinded allies now deal more damage.

skills.name: Blind Fury
skills.targets: The central enemy and surrounding enemies
skills.description: Deals magic damage to the central enemy and surrounding enemies. Blinded enemies take increased damage.

skills.name: Gift of the Storm
skills.trigger: Each time Miu or her allies land a Critical Hit
skills.description: Each time Miu or her allies land a Critical Hit, their Magic Penetration is increased for 5.0 seconds. This skill triggers once every 5 seconds.

skills.name: Blinding Stormcloud
skills.fallback_target: The central enemy if all enemies are Blinded
skills.description: Every 10 seconds, blinds the nearest non-Blinded enemy for 6.0 seconds. If all enemies are Blinded, the central enemy takes damage.

skills.name: Eternal Blindness
skills.description: The duration of all Blindness effects is increased by 3.0 seconds.

artifacts.name: Rainy Season
artifacts.effect: Magical Crit Hit Chance bonus to the whole team

synergies.name: Electra
synergies.reason: One of Miu's strongest partners. Electra applies Blind, buffs the team's Magic Attack, reduces enemy Magic Defense, and can tank magic damage. Together they amplify Magical Crit and Magic Penetration for explosive magic damage.

synergies.name: Polaris
synergies.reason: Polaris aplica stun nos inimigos e inimigos atordoados sofrem mais dano mágico, Poralis tem artefato de arma que consede bônus de chance de acerto crítico mágico para toda a equipe, e o controle adicional ajuda a manter os inimigos sob os efeitos de cegueira de Miu enquanto polaris se beneficia dos buffs de Miu de ataque mágico e perfuração mágica para causar mais dano mágico.

synergies.name: Satori
synergies.reason: A magic burst DPS that benefits directly from Miu's Magical Crit support and Magic Penetration buffs. Blinded enemies are also less able to avoid his damage windows.

synergies.name: Folio
synergies.reason: Provides steady magic damage, benefits from Magical Crit Hit Chance, and scales well with extra Magic Penetration, making Miu's support package consistently valuable.

synergies.name: Peppy
synergies.reason: Adds extra control and magic damage through Blind, Stun, and Slow, helping keep enemy debuffs active and increasing Miu's overall battlefield value.

synergies.name: Aurora
synergies.reason: A durable magic-oriented tank with dodge, magic shielding, and passive magic damage. Aurora keeps the team alive while Miu enables the backline damage dealers.

special_interactions.reason: Additional Blindness from enemy heroes can still interact favorably with Miu's kit because blinded allies always hit enemies and their attacks cannot be evaded while Lightning Strike's effect is active.

notes: Miu é Forte contra times de Esquiva: Dante, Aurora, Octavia.
Realm skills are not available yet.
Only Talisman of Storm is available at the moment.
The source notes listed Eternal Blindness both as a skill enhancement and as a new legendary skill at relic level 30; both entries were preserved for later in-game verification.
